11.title: Prepare whole-project route and development handoff

<!-- spec:start -->
baseline_commit: 1ca41261f87b505610a70c5018f2bafac30c4b97
Outcome: prepare Kit Desk's whole accepted scope for another Corpo to begin useful development from shared repository/native work alone.
Scope: adopt existing project/input facts into accessible technical owners; form a coarse full-scope delivery route, actionable near-term architecture and first executable work; document the real commands and remaining scaffold gaps; publish local Git preparation and recoverable handoff.
Acceptance: another instance can locate product/inputs/maintenance boundaries, understand all five capabilities and stage prerequisites, identify the first work and direct checks, and distinguish input checks/preparation from unimplemented application behavior. Verify the shared commit and native work readback; run existing unittest and Corp checks.
Required Canon: https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/1ca41261f87b505610a70c5018f2bafac30c4b97/product.md and https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/1ca41261f87b505610a70c5018f2bafac30c4b97/inputs/format.md and https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/1ca41261f87b505610a70c5018f2bafac30c4b97/inputs/inventory.csv plus project-owned Corp methods at that commit.
Authority: product.md authorizes ordinary design, native fixture work and local shared Git/main publication. No real network, external services or real GitHub merge. Do not implement the application or claim business delivery in this preparation task.
Unknowns/stops: ordinary internal choices are delegated; stop affected work for a real product/input contradiction or missing authority. No independent successor run is authorized within this task, so readiness remains preparer's verified handoff until separately consumed.
Lasting facts: product.md owns goals; inputs/format.md owns inventory file format; docs/architecture.md will own module/data/command boundaries; native Milestones own stage agreements and Issue Specs own executable outcomes. README and Corp entry route to those owners.

12.title: Implement persistent inventory import and available-item search
12.body:
<!-- spec:start -->
baseline_commit: b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532
Outcome: a volunteer can import inventory CSV and find available equipment by name/category across separate CLI invocations. This is the first runnable application slice for Milestone 1.
Required versioned inputs: https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532/product.md (goal/authority), https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532/inputs/inventory.csv (fictional sample), https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532/inputs/format.md (accepted persisted inventory JSON), https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532/docs/architecture.md (adopted CSV/storage/CLI/component boundaries), and https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/b821805165a8f94412c4c399f578319243f29532/README.md (actual contributor checks). Use project-owned Corp methods at the same baseline. Preparation evidence is Issue 11; inspect its shared result rather than trusting only closure.
Scope and maintenance: create the missing repository-root kitdesk package, CLI entrypoint, CSV validation/filter logic and inventory storage boundary described in docs/architecture.md; add tests/test_inventory.py and tests/test_cli.py to standard unittest discovery; update README when commands really run. There is currently no application scaffold: creating the minimal runnable package is owned by this work, not an unavailable prerequisite. Preserve tests/test_inputs.py's separate Issue 9 work.
Interfaces: python3 -m kitdesk --data-dir PATH import CSV; python3 -m kitdesk --data-dir PATH search [--name TEXT] [--category TEXT]. Persist inventory.json in accepted version-1 format. Filters are case-insensitive substrings combined with AND; output id,name,category CSV sorted by ID with a header even for no matches. Every item is available before loan integration.
Acceptance: import inputs/inventory.csv in a temporary directory then query in another process and obtain K1 for tripod/camera and K2 for audio. No-filter lists both; combined filters and no matches are correct. Duplicate/empty/whitespace IDs, invalid fields, malformed rows and wrong CSV headers fail with nonzero exit and actionable stderr, without changing existing inventory bytes or creating an inventory on first-import failure. Search rejects corrupt/unsupported JSON clearly without resetting state. Inspect persisted JSON with the standard JSON reader to prove accepted schema. No third-party dependency or network is required.
Direct checks: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests must include the new unit/subprocess scenarios; python3 .agents/corp/check.py; invoke the real entrypoint with --help and the sample import/search round trip. Record exact shared candidate SHA and results. Test results establish only the checked behavior; Milestone 1 acceptance still follows its fixed integrated candidate and independent review trigger.
Boundaries/unknowns: no checkout, return or loan export implementation in this issue; all remain mandatory in linked Milestone 2. Loan record schema and later command spelling are deliberately deferred. Concurrency beyond sequential separate invocations is outside initial scope. If an existing active holder, changed required pin or true source conflict affects this slice, stop that scope and use the current Corp coordination/Spec procedure; resolve ordinary internal design directly.
Lasting facts: code/tests own implementation and checks; docs/architecture.md owns changed shared interfaces; inputs/format.md retains inventory schema; README owns actually runnable commands; Milestone/Issue comments own progress and exact-version evidence. Local commits and local shared Git publication are authorized by product.md; no real GitHub merge/network or external notifications.
<!-- spec:end -->

21.title: Implement durable inventory import and search
21.body:
A volunteer can now import the supplied inventory and search it in later CLI invocations. The implementation creates the runnable kitdesk package, validates the complete CSV and version-1 JSON, atomically replaces inventory, and emits ID-sorted CSV search results. Rejected input preserves existing bytes; corrupt existing JSON is reported instead of reset. README and architecture status now match the runnable slice.

Issue: https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/12
Spec pin: issue=12 spec_sha256=4b7bf3b2ff2ecd99add03c63f1f601d8bd974bb5a28adcf17ca2a943a6295aaf accepted=https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/12#issuecomment-7

Validation on clean head, Python 3.14.2: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passed 13 tests; python3 .agents/corp/check.py passed (15 documents, 3 methods, 6 Python helpers); git diff --check passed; python3 -m kitdesk --help passed. Real separate-process sample import then tripod/camera search returned K1, audio returned K2, unfiltered search returned both; standard csv/json readers verified output and persisted version-1 records. Tests include malformed headers/rows, duplicate and whitespace IDs, missing fields, first-import rejection, corrupt/unsupported JSON, atomic replacement-failure cleanup and availability filtering boundary.

No application integration exists on shared/main yet; this PR and shared feature branch carry the complete candidate. Stage reviewer must be a non-implementer and use the installed milestone-delivery/review methods with native coordination. Loan checkout, returns and export remain mandatory Milestone 2 work. 2.title: Complete a durable lending cycle and active-loan export
2.description:
Outcome: a volunteer finds an available item, checks it out to a fictional borrower alias, observes it unavailable in a new process, returns it, and exports active loans. Preserve inventory import/search from stage 1. Product source: https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/1ca41261f87b505610a70c5018f2bafac30c4b97/product.md.
Prerequisite: usable persistent inventory/lookup boundary from https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/milestone/1; begin integration after that result is obtainable, not merely after a closed flag. At stage entry create/refine executable work using actual stage-1 code and accepted pins.
Acceptance scenarios: separate invocations persist checkouts/returns; double checkout and unknown item/invalid alias fail clearly without state changes; available search excludes active loans and includes returned items; CSV export contains exactly active loans and item/borrower identity, with a header for an empty set. Import cannot orphan active loans. Run subprocess integration tests in the standard unittest entry and full regression from a fixed shared candidate.
Evidence: application behavior checks plus independent integrated-stage review under docs/corp/milestone-delivery.md. No real deployment, service or notifications. Only after applicable review/corrections/integration and final-version checks can the accepted local-tool scope be recorded delivered. Next direction: explicit project completion against all product.md capabilities, with nonblocking improvements separately identified.
